name: token-finops-status
description: Status-bar runway indicator for token-finops (Copilot/Claude Code/Codex/Gemini CLI/Cline/Roo/Kilo/... budget tracker), with a click-through detail view.

tokenFinops.cliPath.description: Binary/wrapper used only for the manual 'Refresh Now' command (e.g. 'uv run token-finops' if not on PATH). Not used for the periodic status-bar tick, which reads the cache file directly.

tokenFinops.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the status bar re-reads ~/.token-finops/last.json. This never spawns a process; it only re-reads the cache written by whatever refresh timer you already have running (cron, contrib/refresh, another widget's --fresh call, or this extension's own 'Refresh Now' command).

tokenFinops.showAll.description: Include UNLIMITED (usage-only, no allowance) tools in the status bar and detail view, matching 'token-finops status --all'.
